decisions.reason: The coolant cleaning centrifuge sits squarely in our core coolant-treatment portfolio and should be retained to build installed base, service revenue and sustainability benefits.
The coolant nozzle range complements existing systems and supports cross-selling, although individual models could be adjusted without withdrawing the line.
The scraper belt chip conveyor remains a relevant adjacency for integrated material-flow solutions, but as a more peripheral variant it carries a somewhat higher portfolio-rationalisation risk.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor fits directly with our established chip-handling business and integrated factory offering, so withdrawal is unlikely absent clearly weak demand.
The hinged belt chip conveyor broadens our conveyor coverage for metalworking customers, though overlapping variants make it slightly more exposed if we streamline the range.
